item.title: Blake chasing American dream through Blackburn Rovers Sports College
item.description: Through Blackburn Rovers Sports College, Blake is working towards achieving his dream of studying in the United States after joining the Level Three Sports Diploma five months ago. Delivered by Blackburn Rovers Community Trust, the official charity of Blackburn Rovers, the Sports College was recommended to 16-year-old Blake by a friend who had previously attended. item.description: Another busy weekend in the Sky Bet Championship brought important results across the division, with teams fighting for promotion, play-off places and survival all shaping the latest twists in the table. item.title: Sky Bet League One Round-Up: Cardiff City strengthen title credentials as Lincoln City drop points
item.description: Cardiff City strengthened their Sky Bet League One title credentials with a convincing 3-1 win over Luton Town in the Welsh capital. A result that extends their lead at the summit, three first-half goals from David Turnbull, Joel Colwill and Perry Ng were enough to secure the points despite a Jordan Clark penalty briefly bringing Luton back into the contest. item.title: Sky Bet League Two Round-Up: Cambridge United earn statement win to move second
item.description: Cambridge United earned a statement victory over Bristol Rovers to move up to second in the Sky Bet League Two table. Ben Knight opened the scoring just after half an hour before Joe Quigley got the visitors back into it from the penalty spot. But it was The U's who raced away with things after the break, with Ben Knight completing his brace and Kell Watts' header securing the points.
